messages:
Priya: Quick follow-up on sticky-lease idea: add a per-prefix "sticky_threshold" (seconds) so a relinquish only happens if usage below threshold for that duration.

Ben: Nice. How does this fit with eviction and prefetch? If a prefix is sticky we shouldn't evict its cached KV even under pressure?

Priya: Not permanent. Sticky just raises eviction priority penalty for threshold window. If memory pressure forces it we still evict but prefer demote after threshold expiry.

Iris: We need a safety valve: a global memory-override that can ignore sticky for emergency reductions. Also expose sticky_hit/miss metrics.

Ben: Agreed. Also implement as lease metadata: {epoch, sticky_until, reason}. Clients can pass expected_epoch on writes to avoid split-brain.

Priya: Proto config: sticky_threshold_s=10, sticky_penalty=0.8, global_override=true. Will spike with hotkey generator and 2x surge to measure extra handoffs.

ops-bot: Metric names suggested: prefix.sticky.evictions_prevented, prefix.sticky.override_count. Logged to https://internal/metrics/prefix-sticky

Iris: Testing note: simulate tenant migration where a bunch of prefixes flip owners; ensure sticky doesn't create long-term imbalance. Add TTL on sticky metadata to prevent permanent stickiness.

Priya: Good call. I'll run the spike and post results here tomorrow. If numbers look good we'll add to RFC as a soft option behind feature-flag.
